meta.title: Careers / Open roles | Cluega
meta.description: Join Cluega and help build the team defining the next generation of AI marketing. Explore open roles, benefits, and our team culture across regions.

hero.title: We're redefining the future of AI-driven marketing
hero.subtitle: Join the core team building the world's first Outcome-as-a-Service advertising intelligence platform.

mission.statement: Build an AI-native, full-funnel marketing operating system that moves brands from "paying for tools" to "paying for outcomes."
mission.body1: Cluega AI is the world's first outcome-driven advertising decision platform (AdOS). We're the first to bring the Model Context Protocol (MCP) to marketing, turning insight, creative, delivery, and attribution from tedious manual work into second-by-second automated decisions.
mission.body2: Rooted in R&D out of Ho Chi Minh City, Vietnam, we're building commercial teams across Southeast Asia, Greater China, Europe, and North America to construct the next generation of global marketing infrastructure.

gmv.label: Target annual ad GMV under management

engineers.label: Engineers at the Ho Chi Minh City tech center

pay.name: Competitive pay + equity
pay.description: A salary structure benchmarked against global AI companies at the same stage; early employees receive substantial equity, with pay set to each local market's benchmark.

globalVision.name: Global exposure & travel
globalVision.description: Attend the world's top expos — GDC, Gamescom, Affiliate World — and work directly with core brands and media agencies across Europe, the Americas, and APAC.

growth.name: Fast-track growth
growth.description: Outcome-driven, not seniority-driven. At a first-tier company in the AdOS space, your impact is the speed of your growth.

aiTech.name: Frontier AI environment
aiTech.description: A company-wide MCP-protocol architecture puts you first in line for the most cutting-edge LLM applications in marketing: creative generation, delivery automation, and attribution modeling.

localCare.name: Localized employee care
localCare.description: Differentiated benefits by location: a Grade A office + meal allowance in Ho Chi Minh City; flexible remote work + wellness stipend in Europe and the Americas.

learning.name: A learning organization
learning.description: Regular cross-border tech talks and AI-tool training; core innovations like the Dogclaw attribution model are incubated in-house — everyone is encouraged to be a real problem-solver.

roles.title: We're looking for kindred minds around the world
roles.subtitle: Join Cluega AI and become a definer, not a follower, in the golden window of the AdOS space.

values.title: This is how we operate at Cluega
values.subtitle: The core values that guide us across regions and drive global growth.

results.name: Outcomes are everything
results.description: We don't charge tool fees; we let brands pay for outcomes. Every decision points to measurable growth, not the completion of a process — no matter which city you work in.

speed.name: Speed is competitiveness
speed.description: Second-by-second automated decisions from insight to delivery are our core promise. In the AdOS space, first movers define the rules — we aim to be a step ahead in every market.

globalLocal.name: Global thinking, local execution
globalLocal.description: Rooted in R&D in Southeast Asia, with Europe, the Americas, and APAC as our market stage. Cross-cultural collaboration is our daily norm — we believe the best answers come from diverse perspectives.
